result.title: Random Symbolic Boosting: A Geometric Approach to Symbolic Regression
result.summary: Symbolic models offer interpretability, but their construction through generational evolution can be computationally expensive. This article presents Random Symbolic Boosting (RSB), a method that constructs explicit additive symbolic models via boosting over populations of randomly generated syntax trees, eliminating the need for generational evolution. The idea combines two observations: high-dimensional spaces can be spanned by enough linearly independent vectors, and the semantics of syntax trees can be directly manipulated as such vectors. It is shown that, for Ordinary Least Squares, the boosting process guarantees a monotonic reduction of the training error for both regression and classification. Furthermore, an adaptive geometric early stopping mechanism is introduced. It is based on the angle between the prediction and target vectors, is independent of the problems scale, and requires no adjustments across tasks. Evaluated on a standard benchmark for symbolic regression, the method is located at the Pareto-optimal point between predictive accuracy and training time, ranking first on the real-world datasets. Additionally, it was tested on a large tabular classification benchmark with 200 problems, achieving competitive results.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Random Symbolic Boosting，用 boosting 在随机生成的语法树种群上直接构建可解释的加性符号模型以替代世代进化，并引入基于预测向量与目标向量夹角、与问题尺度无关的自适应几何早停机制；在符号回归基准与 200 个表格分类任务上评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 其尺度无关、跨任务免调参的角度式早停准则，可能为 LVR 中动态计算与 STOP 决策的停止判据提供可核查线索，但研究对象是符号模型拟合而非视觉 latent 推理状态，联系仅为概念层面。
